subject: Recap + POC plan & next steps (Aurora Systems)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aurora-systems.com>, Tom Garcia <tgarcia@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + POC plan & next steps (Aurora Systems)

Thanks again for a great conversation today — really appreciate the context on the evaluation goals. Per our call, summary and proposed POC plan below so we’re all aligned before kickoff.

Quick recap (what success looks like)
- Product: reduce average latency for "search-assist" generation flows while matching current relevance baseline.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th perc latency < 250ms at 512-token typical requests; throughput >= 50 rps for benchmark test; relevance score >= 0.85 on your labeled eval set; unit cost <= $0.025 per 1k tokens (target).

Evaluation plan
- Test dataset: Aurora will provide ~1.5k representative prompts + labeled relevance judgments (Samantha to share by 2026-08-21).
- Runs: baseline run (current infra), Redwood run with suggested model/quantization profile, and a tuned configuration.
- Metrics & artifacts: latency percentiles, tokens/sec, cost estimate, qualitative examples.

Timeline & milestones (proposed)
- Pre-flight: Aug 24 — environment connectivity check & smoke test (Redwood SE).
- Kickoff: Aug 25, 10:00 AM PT — align on data, success criteria, schedule.
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays, 30 min, standing (Aug 28, Sep 4, Sep 11).
- Final readout: week of Sep 21 (detailed report + decision meeting).

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead / commercial), Ethan Park (SE / technical lead), Laura Bennett (CS liaison).
- Aurora: Samantha Lee (product owner), Tom Garcia (infra/IT), Procurement (contract/SOW).

Immediate next steps
1) Samantha to confirm kickoff date/time (proposed Aug 25, 10am PT).
2) Aurora to share test dataset + sample API keys / allowlist info by Aug 21.
3) Redwood to send POC checklist, proposed weekly agenda, and SOW for signature (DocuSign link).
4) Schedule pre-flight smoke test for Aug 24.

Attachments: Aurora_POC_Scope_v1.pdf, trial-config.yml (attached).

Thanks — sending calendar invite after we confirm kickoff.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Recap + POC plan & next steps (Aurora Systems)

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what Tom and I discussed internally. A couple quick notes:
- Success criteria look right; can we add a soft target for 99th perc latency for monitoring purposes?
- Final readout week-of Sep 21 works but can we target Sep 23 for the decision meeting (gives procurement a little more runway).

We can confirm kickoff on Aug 25 at 10:00 AM PT — I’ll block that on our side. I’ll also send the test dataset and labeled eval file by EOD Aug 21. I’ve CCed procurement to start reviewing the SOW.

Could you also send a one-page checklist we can forward to Tom (infra) so he knows what ports/IPs to open and what sample payloads look like?

Appreciate it — excited to get started.

—
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager\Aurora Systems

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Recap + POC plan & next steps (Aurora Systems)

Quick tech notes for the pre-flight and smoke test:
- Ports/IPs: allowlist outbound to 52.12.34.56 and 34.56.78.90 (HTTPS).
- API: we’ll provide a short-lived test key for the smoke. Sample payloads are in trial-config.yml.
- Recommended baseline config: model-family: redwood-guest-medium, quantization: q4_0, batch_size: 8 for latency runs; increase to 32 for throughput tests.
- Data: please strip PII from the test prompts; encrypted upload to our Drive folder is preferred.

I can own the pre-flight on Mon Aug 24 between 9–12 PT — happy to run it with Tom on a quick Zoom and validate connectivity and a 5–10 request smoke run.

On the SOW: one minor redline we discussed on price floors — Laura, I’ll sync with you and Marissa before sending back to procurement.

—
